title: Port the repo agent instructions to the allowed claude-code and opencode harnesses
description: Create AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at the root of the mongodb-mcp-server checkout (applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, OnFinance fork, default branch main), carrying over the build, test and repository-convention guidance currently shipped in .github/copilot-instructions.md so that claude-code and opencode - the only harnesses in sdlc/policy.json aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed - consume it. Keep the guidance data-class-appropriate (public/internal only, no client PII or financial data). Constraints: trunk-based development on protected branch main, one approving reviewer (codeReview.minApprovers 1), blocking gitleaks and vitest CI gates, semgrep SAST advisory above high; repo-content-only change, so no deployment window or change freeze applies.
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md exist at the root of applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server on the fork's main branch and carry the guidance previously in .github/copilot-instructions.md (build and test commands, repo conventions)
Starting claude-code or opencode in the checkout loads the new project instruction files without errors (session rules list names AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md)
The PR branch CI run is green on the blocking gitleaks and vitest gates

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer compares the PR diff adding AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md section-by-section against the .github/copilot-instructions.md being replaced: expected result - every guidance section survives, wording is harness-neutral with no Copilot/gh-aw-specific instruction, and the files sit at repo root so both allowed harnesses load them.

rootCause.description: Repo guidance shipped only as GitHub Copilot harness configuration; no instruction file existed for the harnesses actually allowed by aiCodingPolicy.harnessesAllowed (claude-code, opencode)
